Native-safe / unavailable-behaviour notes: react-i18next, lucide-react, @/lib/cn, framer-motion (via FadeIn) and the DOM <div>/<span> hosts have no native parity — mapped to View/AppText/StyleSheet + emoji Glyph; the user tz/locale settings cascade behind useDateFormat is unavailable on native so formatDate uses the device locale; the reused useRefreshTeslaOrders hook additionally surfaces its own Alert feedback, so this component's banner intentionally mirrors the web component's *own* explicit toast (the web likewise double-fires hook + component toasts).

No DOM-only modules, browser HTML elements, Recharts, Leaflet, or old web UI components imported — only React + react-native primitives (ActivityIndicator/Platform/Pressable/StyleSheet/View), the native shared AppText/GlassPanel + theme tokens, and the web-parity Badge/FadeIn + useUser hooks.
